confidence_notes: Restaurant and drink anchors come from aggregator and crowdsourced Heidelberg or German price pages dated 2021 to 2026, which differ by roughly 10-20%; beer and cappuccino are the best-supported. Cocktail and wine_glass have no direct Heidelberg source and are set from the local beer price (cocktail about 2.3x beer, wine glass about 1.2x beer). Hostel and hotel anchors are holistic model estimates, not checked against live listings. EUR figures were converted at about 1.16 USD per EUR, taken from a currency conversion in a search result rather than a live rate. The FX observation came from a search summary of the RBA overview page, which I did not open directly, and the 0.6955 value is not checked against the RBA F11 table.
comparable_city_reasoning: Food and drink anchors use Heidelberg-specific aggregator figures, cross-checked against German averages. Drink anchors for cocktail and wine_glass use a beer-relationship basis. Accommodation anchors are a holistic estimate benchmarked by general knowledge against mid-sized German university and tourist cities.
